_comment: Ontology for the ArkhitX Framework itself. Defines the types of nodes that govern how every project (including ArkhitX) must behave.

GovernanceRule.description: A mandatory architectural rule extracted from .cursorrules that all ArkhitX-governed projects must follow. AI sessions are grounded against these nodes so that rule violations are caught before they reach production.

description.description: Full rule text as written in .cursorrules

layer.description: Which ArkhitX layer this rule governs: SDK | Governance | Knowledge | Ontology | All

phase.description: Earliest project phase at which this rule is checked (0-3)

enforcement.description: How compliance is verified: structural | gate | test | audit

verifiable.description: Whether compliance can be automatically checked

violated_by.description: Example of a common violation pattern

ProjectPhase.description: One of the four ArkhitX governance phases that every registered project must pass through in order.

name.description: Phase name (Build | Register | Populate Graph | Wire Governance)

entry_gate.description: Condition that must be true before entering this phase

exit_artifact.description: What must exist on disk / in DB when this phase is complete

ArchitectureDecision.description: A top-level structural decision about how ArkhitX is built. These are the non-negotiable constraints that shape every implementation choice.

consequences.description: What this decision means for implementations

ENFORCED_IN.description: Links a GovernanceRule to the ProjectPhase where it is checked

SUPPORTS.description: Links a GovernanceRule to the ArchitectureDecision it supports
